title: Walk After Meals
hook: What if you walked after every meal?
banner:
WALK AFTER MEALS
GET FIT FAST

beats.label: 5 MIN
beats.line: your leg muscles start pulling glucose, flattening the blood‑sugar spike.
beats.idea: Character walking, glowing glucose particles moving from bloodstream into leg muscles.

beats.label: 15 MIN
beats.line: insulin sensitivity rises, letting cells soak up sugar faster.
beats.idea: Close‑up of cells lighting up as insulin icons zip in.

beats.label: 30 MIN
beats.line: your stomach empties a bit faster, easing heartburn.
beats.idea: Stomach cartoon with a timer, bubbles fading as food moves down.

beats.label: 1 HR
beats.line: blood triglycerides stay low, easing heart strain after the feast.
beats.idea: Blood vessel with fat droplets shrinking, heart beating calmly.

beats.label: 2 HR
beats.line: metabolism stays revved, burning extra calories for hours.
beats.idea: Silhouette with a gentle flame behind, calories icons disappearing.

description: A quick walk after meals triggers a cascade of metabolic benefits, from smoother blood sugar to lasting calorie burn.

facts.claim: Walking for 5 minutes after a meal reduces postprandial blood glucose spikes.
A short post‑meal walk improves insulin sensitivity for up to two hours.
Light activity after eating speeds gastric emptying, lowering heartburn risk.
Walking after a meal lowers postprandial triglyceride levels.
Post‑meal walking raises metabolic rate for several hours, increasing calorie burn.

end.line: Will you walk after your next bite?

topic: What happens if you walk after each meal?
